messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - GPU capacity shortage detected in us-west-2. Autoscaler failing to provision GPU-backed nodes (quota/timeout). Impact: increased 5xx for realtime inference, some Dedicated customers report degraded throughput. Logs show repeated 'quotaExceeded' from cloud provider. Paging oncall.

sara: ack. looking at autoscaler logs now, grabbing recent stack traces.

mike: i'm on infra. quick note: autoscaler API calls are returning 429 then timeouts, then the reconcile loop backs off. might be hitting both regional quota and provider-side capacity shortage.

liam: i can try manual failover to us-east while we triage — can we route some traffic to the us-east pool? any customers pinned to region?

sara: a few enterprise customers pinned to us-west. we should only failover non-pinned requests. mike, can you add a temporary route to route policy that prefers us-east for new sessions?

mike: doing it now. patching routing policy:
```yaml
routing:
  - match: request.region=="us-west-2" && customer.pin==false
    action: prefer_region(us-east-1)
```
applying...

mike: patched. adding a manual scale to us-east GPU pool (using preemptible capacity) to absorb traffic spike.

liam: running manual scale:
```bash
rcli scale --pool gpu-standard --region us-east-1 --replicas 18 --type preemptible
# output: success - queued 18 nodes, expected ready ~4-6m
```

oncall-bot: Handoff reminder set — next handoff to @nina in 40 minutes.

ashley: @sara @mike please add short customer impact note for sales and cs: which customers hit, ETA for mitigation, suggested messaging. i'll coordinate comms when we have numbers.

sara: quick customer list: AcmeCorp (pinned, partial degradation), Streamly (non-pinned so should route to us-east now), BetaAI (batch only, unaffected). i'll add details to the incident doc.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook check: autoscaler-backoff-v2 matches symptoms. Suggested mitigation steps executed: manual-scale, route-preference. Remaining: review autoscaler retry logic and provider quota handling.

mike: us-east pool nodes are joining, 12/18 ready. realtime 5xx errors dropping from 12% -> 3% over the last 6 minutes. routing shift applied. looks like immediate mitigation working. :white_check_mark:

liam: observing increased tail latency for a subset of requests routed cross-region ~ +40ms. team ok with that tradeoff for throughput?

sara: yes — prefer availability over latency for now. note for postmortem: consider smarter client-side session affinity to avoid cross-region spikes.

mike: digging into cloud provider quota logs — they returned 'Insufficient capacity for requested instance type (p4d) in us-west-2' + rate-limited quota errors. looks like a provider-side shortage combined with aggressive scale attempts tripping rate limits.

nina: (joining) thanks for the handoff. quick summary for me: mitigation in place (route -> us-east, manual scale), customer impact reduced but AcmeCorp still partial degraded. next steps?

sara: confirm AcmeCorp is pinned; sales will need a dedicated note. we'll maintain manual scale and monitor until we can ensure autoscaler retry backoff fixed. also open track ticket for reserved capacity for key customers.

ashley: creating follow-up tickets and scheduling postmortem. draft here: INFRA-5423: "GPU capacity & autoscaler resilience - root cause & remediation". owners: mike (autoscaler fix), liam (regional failover test + runbook), sara (customer comms), nina (capacity reservation owner). ETA: initial remediation plan in 2 weeks.

mike: starting a short live patch: extend autoscaler backoff window and add exponential retry to avoid rapid retries when provider returns 5xx/429. pushing a canary now.

sara: note to self: gather metric windows for 30m before incident -> 2h after for PM. I'll attach to postmortem.

ops-runbook-bot: Canary diff applied: autoscaler v2.1.1-canary - backoff increased from 30s -> 3m. Monitor for side effects.

mike: canary looks stable, no new 429s for 10m from autoscaler. promoting patch to prod.

liam: creating remediation checklist in the ticket:
- reserve baseline GPU capacity in us-west-2 for pinned customers
- implement provider capacity detection + graceful degrade to compatible instance types
- autoscaler retry/backoff fixes + unit/integration tests
- add automated regional failover test to CI (simulate us-west capacity loss)
- update runbook with exact commands and handoff checklist

nina: i'll take ownership of the CI failover test and runbook update. linking to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/infra/gpu-capacity-failure

ashley: postmortem meeting proposed: Thu 2026-03-18 10:00 PT. calendar invite to follow. please add anything else to INFRA-5423 before EOD. :calendar: 

sara: assigned INFRA-5423 to owners. adding timeline and initial hypothesis: provider capacity shortage + our aggressive scaling and insufficient backoff -> autoscaler storms + rate-limit.

mike: also adding a short-term mitigation: reserve a minimal pool of warm GPUs in us-west for pinned customers to avoid cold-start risk. will propose cost/benefit in ticket.

liam: for regional failover, we should also evaluate cookie/session affinity TTLs so active sessions don't unexpectedly move. adding to checklist.

ashley: comms: i'll send a concise customer-facing message for affected enterprise customers after we confirm AcmeCorp status with sales.

nina: taking 1hr to stabilize monitoring and then i'll take over incident tracker. for handoff: current status - mitigation active, manual scale in place, AcmeCorp partial degraded, postmortem ticket created.

oncall-bot: Handoff completed to @nina.

ashley: thanks team. action items recap (INFRA-5423):
- mike: autoscaler backoff + testing (owner)
- liam: failover CI test + runbook update (owner)
- sara: metrics & customer impact data + CS note (owner)
- nina: capacity reservation plan + follow-through (owner)
- ashley: coordinate customer comms + postmortem scheduling (owner)
Deadline: initial remediation proposals due in 2 weeks.

mike: logging a retrospective note: consider adding 'fallback instance type' mapping to scheduler to avoid total capacity blockage when preferred types not available.

sara: will attach graphs and query strings in the ticket so postmortem has reproducible artifacts.

ashley: we'll close the incident once AcmeCorp confirms recovery and metrics stable for 30m. please ping here when done. :white_check_mark: 

nina: noticed one remaining error spike 5m ago — investigating, but overall traffic healthy. pinging when cleared.

mike: cleared - all error rates back to baseline for non-pinned traffic, AcmeCorp support ticket updated with mitigation steps.

nina: AcmeCorp confirms partial recovery; CS will monitor. closing incident in tracker once we hit sustained 30m stable.

incident-bot: Incident transitioned to RECOVERY state.

ashley: thanks everyone. follow-ups in INFRA-5423. postmortem invite incoming. :coffee:
